notes:
Lead: Head of Product (Maya Torres) — defending search UX for large enterprise customers.

Summary: Prairie Lark is a mid-market B2B SaaS (collaboration + knowledge base) that wants to replace current keyword search with semantic search powered by embeddings. Primary goals: better relevance for long technical docs, faster cold-start for new customer workspaces, and nightly batch refresh of embeddings for delta docs. They plan to start on Hosted API for speed of integration and then move to Dedicated when throughput and cost become predictable.

On the initial call:
- "We need vector recall to feel instantaneous for users across regions — <200ms typical UI target." — product.
- Discussed current infra: Postgres + Elasticsearch for metadata, Postgres storing doc blobs, Push pipeline for embeddings using an async job runner (Sidekiq). Nightly batch is ~120k docs, average doc size 6KB, expect ~10M tokens per night.
- Prototype wishlist: embeddings index in Pinecone or Milvus; want Redwood to drive embeddings pipeline and provide a cost/latency forecast for Hosted vs Dedicated.

Security & Compliance notes:
- SAML required for admin console, SOC2 is on their checklist (they will need SOC2 report from vendor).
- Data residency preference: EU tenant data must live in eu-central-1 region for customers with EU contracts.

Pricing sensitivity:
- Finance: prefers committed monthly spend if unit costs drop by >20% versus pay-as-you-go. Looking for clear guidance on break-even point for switching to Dedicated.

Quote from SE call: "If Dedicated can handle nightly 10M token re-ingests with KV cache priming and still keep UI latency <200ms for queries, we buy. Otherwise we need a hybrid route."

Internal CRM shorthand:
- POC scope: Hosted embeddings + vector index integration; test throughput for 1000 qps read burst, nightly 120k doc re-ingest with batching and checkpointing; measure token spend and latency SLOs.
- Risk: timeline for SAML integration and security questionnaire completion (legal needs vendor SOC2).

Docs shared: pricing deck, security FAQ, POC runbook (linked). Follow-ups: Dedicated sizing call w/ infra + pricing, SE to draft POC test plan, finance to sign NDA amendment for pricing conversation.
